popCulture.title: Minotaur
popCulture.description: The labyrinth's bull-man — Theseus' thread and Ariadne's gift still define how the West imagines the maze.

popCulture.title: Ariadne
popCulture.description: The princess who arms the hero against her brother — then waits on Naxos for a god instead of a king.

popCulture.title: Theseus
popCulture.description: Athens' founder-hero whose Cretan deed — killing the Minotaur — remains his most retold exploit.
